name: Goretusk Liver Pie
summary: At the Saldean Farm in Westfall, Salma Saldean is making pie through hard times. Bandits have ravaged the kingdom’s breadbasket, and homesteaders hunt aggressive boars to feed their families.

sections.title: Frontier Hospitality
sections.body: Westfall once fed Stormwind as its fertile breadbasket. Now neglected roads, roving outlaws, and overgrown fields make life hard for the few settlers who remain. At the Saldean Farm, Salma Saldean works to keep a sense of home despite the dangers. A traditional meat pie offers one of the few comforts to homesteaders trying to preserve their way of life.

sections.title: Westfall's Feral Beasts
sections.body: Goretusks roam Westfall’s plains in great numbers. Their tough hides and vicious tusks make them dangerous to farmhands alone, yet their meat feeds families cut off from regular trade. Salma’s recipe calls for crushed rosemary, minced garlic, chopped dill, and simmering gravy. Prepared with care, the beasts’ pungent organs become a rich, savory meal.

faq.answer: Salma Saldean is a resilient homesteader who lives with her husband, Farmer Saldean, at their farm in central Westfall. Her home-cooked meals lift spirits despite the dangers from bandits and wild beasts.

faq.q: Why does Salma want goretusk livers?
aliases: what is the pie made of
faq.answer: Salma wants goretusk livers for her famous savory meat pie, which she is preparing to share with her husband. The crust is baked and the seasonings are ready; only the livers remain before she can finish simmering the filling.

faq.q: Where are goretusks typically found in Westfall?
faq.answer: Goretusks roam across Westfall’s golden plains and fallow farm plots, rooting through abandoned fields and wandering along dirt roads.

faq.q: Are goretusks dangerous to the local farmers?
faq.answer: Yes. Goretusks are aggressive, territorial wild boars with sharp tusks. They threaten livestock and pose a significant danger to unprotected travelers across the plains.

faq.q: Why is food so scarce in Westfall right now?
faq.answer: Food is scarce because Stormwind gives little support and organized bandits raid the farms. Many farmers have been driven from their land, leaving the kingdom’s former breadbasket an impoverished frontier.

faq.q: Does completing this task help the Saldean farm survive?
faq.answer: Fresh meat cannot solve Westfall’s broader crises, but it helps sustain the Saldean family and gives travelers hearty rations for the road ahead.

angles.text: Salma’s dish reflects rural human cooking. Garden herbs like garlic, rosemary, and dill weed turn wild game offal into a staple meal.
Helping rural homesteaders like the Saldeans supports loyal human families struggling to hold the kingdom’s frontier without Stormwind’s army.
